how: Each shot is a real playthrough by the scripted autopilot in game/src/shots.js, which plays the game by its own rules (move, interact, serve) and freezes the frame at a chosen moment. No frames are edited or composited. serve.ts serves the game on localhost:8080; the shots were taken with headless Chrome at 1280x720.

shots.caption: Cover — a salad mid-assembly: chopped tomato on the plate, chopped lettuce in hand, two order tickets, timer running.
Play — a patty sizzling on the stove with flame and progress ring, a burger ticket waiting, coins earned.
Rush — the chef carries a cooked patty to the assembly counter while two tickets run low on patience.
Serve — PERFECT! +16 coins at the serve window after a salad is served on time.

title: BURNER RUSH — a tiny kitchen rush
